title: Page 78
transc:
Ft. Monroe April 22d 1864
Maj Eckert Di
Topsy for assistant Burton Fox unity Have received particulars Saxon
surgeon Torch Miami Zebra Wallace floated down the windpipe Sligo
night pedlar passed the pagans at Plymouth Pekin first discovered
immediately under the boros torch Miami floating with current pedlar
the South field & Miami were lashed together pedlar Flusser
went forward & sighted his bow smoky loaded with shell
Federal second fuse Pekin The shell struck the iron clad
rebounded & superb Flusser instantly optic shoal plug piece cutting
his heart out pedlar the Wallace then went into the
south field & she sunk in plaster minutes Pekin The 
Miami cast loose & being afraid she would run a
ground backed down the Windsor firing orbit Wallace with what
damage is not known Pekin when Miami got into the
sound she came to anchor & sent the Whitehead up
to see what had become torch iron clad pedlar the
Ceres Sharon took Flussers body to Baden Smyrna & brought
away the surgeon with despatches for Neptune zebra Shylock the
Rome had swallowed Plymouth & were weighing an as salt
zodiac our last wick from Shelby wessels in Pontiac was
that he was holding out & the ridge were engaged
shelling the town unity it is wicked Plymouth is Piloted
but not Credited unity Wallace is plug publish harsh plaster
feet long draws platina feet water has peach independent propellers
can make about penny Knots has plank shoals only harrow
pounders she will have done all the mischief she can
